title: Multi-Tier OS Process Sandboxing & Policy Transforms

claims.assertion: Agent execution engines require platform-native sandboxing abstractions to enforce filesystem and network restrictions across Linux, macOS, and Windows

context: Executing arbitrary code or CLI tools in agent loops requires containment to prevent accidental destruction or unauthorized exfiltration.
distilled_learning: Abstract high-level permission profiles (PermissionProfile) into platform-specific native sandbox managers: Linux (Bubblewrap namespace unshare + Landlock ABI rules), macOS (Seatbelt SBPL compiled profiles), and Windows (Restricted Token + Job Object Read Grants).
